blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.
blocks.zh: 代理机器人在机器人控制回路中放置了一款大型语言模型(LLM)代理,由它将感知,运动,和视觉-语言动作(VLA)工具作成于一个内存的引导下,从而在不进行再培训的情况下被概括为新任务. 这种通俗性以高效益为代价。 每个原始人都需要在完整的互动史上进行一轮LLM推理,因此一集的成本随着原始人的数量而增加. 我们认为这一推理在很大程度上是多余的:一旦选择了一个子目标,它的原始就遵循了内存已经规定的常规. 我们介绍Chunk Act, 它引入动作块化 代理机器人。 Online,单调会发射出一整块被链式的原始人,这些原始人只在失败时自动执行并返回控制. 下行,ChunkAct将内存编译入这些块中,因此执行在测试时是无内存的,计划员被保留给需要推理的决定. 因此,LLM的计算以决定数而不是原始数为尺度. 在LIBERO-Pro上,ChunkAct在代理机器人的艺术状态上提高了5.0分,同时需要2.9x更少的LLM调用,4.4x更少的输入符,2.3x更少的输出符.

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agentic robotics has emerged as a new paradigm for robot manipulation ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Kumar, 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Tsui et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026a ) . Rather than training a policy that maps pixels and language directly to motor commands ( Brohan et al., 2023a ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ) , it places a large language model (LLM) agent in the control loop and equips it with perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools, together with a memory of what has worked before. At each step, the agent observes the scene, consults the memory, reasons, and issues a single tool call ( Figure 1 , top). Because each task is composed by reasoning rather than learned from demonstrations, the agent handles new tasks without retraining and succeeds where end-to-end policies break down. For example, with no robot-specific training, GPT-6 Astra driven through a generic agent harness completes a real-arm pick-and-place task in 19 of 20 trials ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Menon et al., 2026 ) and ranks above every public policy on the RoboDojo benchmark ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , which illustrates the generalization this paradigm affords.
blocks.zh: 物剂机器人技术已作为机器人操纵的新范式出现(梁等,2023年;库马尔,2026年;傅等,2026年;徐等,2026年;张等,2026年c;贾等,2026年b;徐等,2026年a). 而不是培训将像素和语言直接映射到运动指令的政策(Brohan等人,2023a); Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ),它将一个大型语言模型(LLM)代理器放入控制循环中,并配备了感知,运动,和视觉语言动作(VLA)工具,同时具备了前作的记忆. 每一步,代理都观察场景,查阅内存,理由,并发布单一工具呼叫(图1,上). 因为每项任务都是通过推理而不是从演示中学习而成,所以代理人不进行再培训就处理新的任务,并在端对端政策破裂的地方取得成功. 例如,在没有机器人专用训练的情况下,GPT-6 Astra通过通用剂牵引完成20次试验中的19次(OpenAI, 2026年;Menon等人, 2026年)的实臂取地任务,并在RoboDojo基准(Zhang等人, 2026年b)的公共政策上名列前茅,这说明了这种范式的概括性。

blocks.en: However, this generalization comes at a steep price in efficiency. The planner acts through primitives, i.e., robot skills invoked as tool calls, each of which requires a dedicated round of LLM reasoning. Every such round reprocesses the full interaction history, and reasoning models further consume output tokens before responding ( Sui et al., 2025 ) . Consequently, the number of calls and output tokens scales linearly with the number of primitives in an episode, while input tokens scale quadratically ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026a ) , as illustrated in Fig. 1 Top. For instance, a single pick-and-place task requires 24.2 LLM calls and 2.2M input tokens on average, costing about $22 per episode with GPT-6 Astra and still $11 even with the cheaper GPT-5.5. 1 1 1 Estimated at OpenAI’s list API prices as of October 2026. As tasks grow longer, this overhead quickly dominates the cost of execution, hindering the scalability of LLM-based agents.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种概括是效率高昂的。 计划者通过原始人来行动,即作为工具调用而引用的机器人技能,每个技术需要专门的一轮LLM推理. 每个这样的回合都会重新处理完整的交互历史,推理模型在回复之前会进一步消耗输出符(Sui等人,2025年). 因此,调用和输出符数与一集中的原始符数成线性比例,而输入符数则以四倍比例(Kapor等人,2024年;Kim等人,2026a年),如图1 Top所示. 例如,单次选址任务平均需要24.2个LLM呼叫和2.2M输入符,每集与GPT-6 Astra的费用大约为22美元,即使是更便宜的GPT-5.5,费用仍然为11美元。 1 1 以OpenAI的API价格计算,截至2026年10月。 随着任务延长,这种间接费用很快占据了执行成本的主导地位,阻碍了基于LLM的代理人的可扩展性.

blocks.en: To address this inefficiency, we analyze the agent’s behavior and find that LLM reasoning is frequently redundant. Once a sub-goal is selected and its targets are localized, the subsequent primitives follow a fixed routine already encoded in memory, such that each additional call merely reproduces a decision that has already been made. Although a single read of memory suffices to capture this routine, the LLM tends to deliberate over each step and constantly returns to memory for guidance. Furthermore, the memory retrieval and LLM reasoning become less reliable as the context grows ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Laban et al., 2026 ) . This overhead could therefore be eliminated by compiling memory into generalizable action sequences that execute without the planner’s step-by-step involvement. This concept also echoes the action chunk Zhao et al. (2023) in robotics.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这种效率低下的问题,我们分析特工的行为,发现LLM推理经常是多余的. 一旦一个次级目标被选中,并且其目标被本地化,之后的原始人遵循一个固定的常规,在记忆中已经编码,因此每次额外的呼叫都只是重复已经作出的决定. 虽然单读记忆就足以捕捉这个常规,但LLM倾向于对每一步进行深思熟虑,并不断返回记忆以进行指导. 此外,随着上下文的增长,内存检索和LLM推理变得不可靠(Liu等人,2024年;Laban等人,2026年)。 因此,可以通过将记忆汇编成在没有规划者逐步参与的情况下执行的一般行动序列来消除这种间接费用。 这个概念也与机器人学中的动作块Zhao等人(2023年)相呼应.

blocks.en:
Building on this observation, we propose ChunkAct (Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics), which consists of two complementary components: chunked execution at test time and memory internalization offline. At test time, ChunkAct introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. It composes the primitives that realize a sub-goal into an executable chunk, which the planner invokes with a single call and which then runs to completion autonomously.
This design confines the LLM to where reasoning is genuinely required: understanding the physical scene, diagnosing failures, and redirecting the plan.
To support this, a failed chunk returns a typed exit that specifies the failed primitive along with an error log, providing the planner with structured feedback for recovery.
In this way, LLM computation scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives (See Fig. 1 Bottom).
Offline, ChunkAct builds these chunks as generalizable routines with memory compiled into them.
The parameters and procedural knowledge that govern each chunk are compiled from memory before deployment, making its actions inherently memory-conditioned.
As a result, chunks run memory-free at test time, eliminating frequent memory retrieval and further improving the efficiency of the LLM.
blocks.zh:
基于这个观察,我们提出Chunk Act(Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics),它由两个互补部分组成:测试时的块执行和内存离线. 在测试时,Chunk Act将动作块化引入代理机器人. 它将实现一个次级目标的原始人组成一个可执行块,规划者用一个呼叫来引用,然后自动完成。
这种设计将LLM限制在真正需要推理的地方:理解物理场景,诊断故障,以及重新定向计划.
为了支持这一点, 一个失败的块返回一个指定失败的原始输出以及一个错误日志, 向计划员提供结构化的恢复反馈 。
这样,LLM用决定数而不是原始数计算尺度(参见图1 Bottom).
离线, ChunkAct 将这些块构建为一般的常规, 并编译为内存 。
管理每个块的参数和程序知识在部署前都从内存中汇编,使其行动具有内存的内在条件。
因此,块在测试时运行无内存,消除了频繁的内存检索,进一步提高LLM的效率.

blocks.en:
Together, these two components improve both efficiency and performance.
By substantially reducing the number of LLM calls and the length of the context, ChunkAct lowers the overall cost of each episode.
Meanwhile, because the planner reasons over a concise context and memory is internalized throughout execution, ChunkAct also achieves higher task success rates (See Fig. 1 Right). To summarize, our contributions are threefold. • To our knowledge, ChunkAct is the first LLM agent for robot manipulation that commits to a chunk of chained perception and control primitives per call rather than to a single primitive. • ChunkAct compiles memory offline into generalizable action chunks, enabling memory-free execution at test time and reserving the LLM for decisions that genuinely require reasoning. • Compared with the previous SOTA agentic robotics approach, ChunkAct improves success by 5.0 points on LIBERO-Pro, while requiring 2.9 × \times fewer LLM calls, 4.4 × \times fewer input tokens, and 2.3 × \times fewer output tokens. It also exhibits strong zero-shot transfer capability.
blocks.zh:
这两个组成部分共同提高效率和业绩。
通过大幅降低LLM通话次数和上下文长度,ChunkAct降低了每集的总成本.
同时,由于规划者对简洁上下文的原因和内存在整个执行过程中被内化,ChunkAct也实现了更高的任务成功率(参见图1 Right). 简言之,我们的贡献是三重的。 据我们所知,ChunkAct是第一个操纵机器人的LLM代理商,它承诺每个调用一个连锁感知和控制原始人,而不是一个单一的原始人. · ChunkAct 将内存离线编译成可通用的动作块,在测试时允许无内存执行,并将LLM保留给真正需要推理的决定. • 支助 与之前的SOTA代理机器人方法相比,ChunkAct在LIBERO-Pro上提高了5.0分的成功率,同时需要2.9×\时减少LLM调用,4.4×\时减少输入令牌,2.3×\时减少输出令牌. 它还显示出强大的零射转射能力。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Language models entered manipulation as planners that sequence a fixed repertoire of skills, grounded in affordances and closed by textual feedback ( Brohan et al., 2023b ; Huang et al., 2022 ) .
Code as Policies turned the plan into a program over perception and control interfaces ( Liang et al., 2023 ) , and later work widened what the program could express with structured prompts, foundation perception, and value maps ( Singh et al., 2022 ; Huang et al., 2023a ; Huang et al., 2023b ; Mu et al., 2024 ) .
A parallel line places a reasoning model above a learned policy rather than around it ( Belkhale et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) .
The two lines have converged in agentic robotics , where an LLM agent sits in the control loop, calls perception, motion, and VLA tools, and keeps a memory of what has worked ( Fu et al., 2026 ; Tsui et al., 2026 ; Kumar, 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026a ) .
All of this work is measured by what the agent can accomplish, and none of it addresses the cost of consulting the planner before every primitive, which has been approached only by caching plans for tasks seen before ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2026a ) .
To our knowledge, we are the first to improve efficiency in agentic robotics systems by consolidating recurring call sequences into reusable action routines.
blocks.zh:
语言模型作为规划者进入操纵状态,对技能的固定循环进行排序,以承受能力为基础,并通过文字反馈而关闭(Brohan等人,2023b); 黄等, 2022).
作为“政策”的守则,计划变成了一个关于感知和控制界面的程序(Liang等人,2023年),后来的工作扩大了方案可以用结构化的提示、基础感知和价值图表达的内容(Singh等人,2022年;Huang等人,2023年a; Huang等人, 2023b; Mu等人, 2024 ).
一条平行线将推理模型置于所学政策之上,而不是围绕着它(Belkhale等人,2024年;Shi等人,2025年;物理智能等人,2025年)。
两条线在代理机器人中汇合在一起,一个LLM剂坐落在控制循环中,呼唤知觉,运动,和VLA工具,并保持了对已起作用的记忆(Fu等人,2026年;Tsui等人,2026年;Kumar,2026年;Jia等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年c;Xu等人,2026年b;Xu等人,2026年a).
所有这些工作都以代理人能够完成哪些工作来衡量,没有任何一项工作涉及在每个原始人之前咨询规划人员的费用,而对于以前看到的任务,只有用缓存计划来处理(Zhang等人,2026a); Kim et al., 2026a ). 金..
据我们所知,我们首先通过将经常性的呼叫序列合并到可重复使用的行动常规中来提高代理机器人系统的效率。

blocks.en:
How many actions a policy commits to per decision is a design choice that trades reactivity against consistency and cost.
Policies that query the model once per control step ( Brohan et al., 2022 ; Brohan et al., 2023a ; Kim et al., 2024 ) tie inference cost to control frequency and let errors compound between queries.
Action chunking, introduced by ACT ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) and adopted by Diffusion Policy ( Chi et al., 2025 ) , predicts a short sequence of actions per inference, and VLA models have since built it into their action heads and tokenizers ( Black et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Pertsch et al., 2025 ) .
Subsequent work tunes the trade-off by interleaving chunks for closed-loop reactivity ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2026 ) , and world-action models extend chunked prediction from actions to future observations ( Du et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026b ) .
In all of these, a chunk is a short sequence of motor commands from a learned policy, and how much an LLM agent should commit to per decision has been asked only in text environments ( Yang et al., 2026 ) .
To our knowledge, we are the first to explore action chunking in agentic robotics, where a chunk spans perception, control primitives, and internalized memory rather than motor commands .
blocks.zh:
一项政策对每项决定所承诺的多少行动是一种设计选择,它与一致性和成本相对应。
对每控制步骤一次查询模型的政策(Brohan等人,2022年;Brohan等人,2023年a年;Kim等人,2024年)将推论成本与控制频率挂钩,使查询之间出现错误。
由ACT(Zhao等人,2023年)引入的、由传播政策(Chi等人,2025年)采纳的动作块化(Chi等人,2025年)预测了每个推论的短序动作,VLA模型从此将动作块集成在其动作头和标注器中(Black等人,2024年;Kim等人,2025年;Pertsch等人,2025年)。
随后的工作通过切换块来调和闭路反应的平衡(Liu等人,2025年;Black等人,2026年),世界行动模型将块化的预测从行动延伸到未来的观测(Du等人,2023年;Wu等人,2024年;Kim等人,2026年b).
在所有这些中,一个块是一个从学习到的政策中获得的短序运动指令,而且仅在文字环境中才要求一个LLM代理人承诺投入多少(Yang等人,2026年)。
据我们所知,我们是第一个探索 动作块化 代理机器人, 其中块块跨 感知,控制原始, 和内化的内存而不是运动命令。

blocks.en:
Memory lets an LLM agent improve without weight updates, and its forms differ in what is stored rather than in how it is used.
Reflective memory stores trajectories or the lessons drawn from them and returns relevant entries to the prompt ( Park et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Packer et al., 2023 ) .
Procedural memory stores what worked as code, from skill libraries ( Wang et al., 2023 ) to induced workflows ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and robot programs adapted to new contexts ( Kagaya et al., 2025 ; Woods and Seifi, 2026 ) .
Robot harnesses keep rule cards and task records written by the planner itself ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , transition conditions between subtasks ( Xu et al., 2026b ) , or a demonstration video navigated at a chosen granularity ( Anonymous, 2026 ) .
In every form, the planner decides what to retrieve and when, reads it into context, and interprets it before acting, so the memory is consumed at test time and its value is bounded by the planner’s ability to use it ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Li et al. (2025) comes closest to breaking this pattern by distilling recurring spans into a datastore that is emitted rather than read, yet its chunks remain text.
We are the first work to explore compiling agentic memory offline into physical action, producing executable action chunks that require no memory access at deployment.
blocks.zh:
内存让一个LLM代理在不更新重量的情况下改进,其形式在存储的内容而不是使用的方式上有所不同.
反射记忆存储轨迹或从中吸取的教训,并将相关条目返回提示(Park等人,2023年;Shinn等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2024年;Packer等人,2023年).
程序内存存储了作为代码有效的东西,从技能库(Wang等人,2023年)到诱导的工作流程(Wang等人,2024年)和适应新环境的机器人程序(Kagaya等人,2025年;Woods and Seifi,2026年).
机器人拉带保留由规划者自己编写的规则卡和任务记录(Zhang等人,2026c),子任务之间的过渡条件(徐等人,2026b),或者在选定的颗粒导航的演示视频(匿名,2026).
在每一种形式中,计划者决定取回什么,何时取回,在上下文中解读,并在行动前解释,因此记忆在测试时消耗,其价值受计划者使用的能力的限制(张等,2025年). 李等编. (2025年)最接近于打破这种模式,方法是将反复出现的跨度蒸馏成一个数据储存库,该数据库被排放而不是读取,但其块仍为文字。
我们是第一个探索将线下代理内存编译为物理动作的工作,产生在部署时不需要内存访问的可执行动作块.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: We begin by formalizing agentic robotics, the setting in which ChunkAct operates.

We analyze the planner’s tool calls and reveal two sources of inefficiency. ❶ The planner conflates deciding with executing. Every primitive incurs a full round of reasoning, even though, once a sub-goal is fixed, the primitives that realize it are largely determined by the memory; the planner is thus invoked far more often than the task demands decisions. ❷ The planner spends most of its calls gathering information rather than acting. Only 20.5% of calls invoke an action primitive, while memory reads and perception account for 31.7% and 44.3%, respectively (See Fig. 2 ).
Since ℳ \mathcal{M} is static across episodes, these reads retrieve the same knowledge again and again, inflating the context without informing new decisions.
These two findings motivate ChunkAct , which brings action chunking to agentic robotics through offline action chunk building ( Section 3.2 ) and online action chunk triggering ( Section 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Offline action chunk building
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 离线动作块建筑

blocks.en:
Targeting the ❶ issue, ChunkAct outputs action chunks rather than single primitives.
The planner is reengaged only when the chunk fails, reserving LLM reasoning for the decisions that require it.
blocks.zh:
ChunkAct公司针对的是QQ问题,
计划员只有在块失败时才重新参与,为需要它的决定保留LLM推理.

blocks.en:
The memory of an LLM agent already records the general, reusable success rules and and procedural context for tasks. ChunkAct compiles all memory once into executable chunk form rather than letting the planner re-derive it at every step ( Figure 3 (a)).
Memory construction begins with a partition over task categories. A manipulation instruction decomposes into an ordered sequence of typed sub-goals, and the space of such types remains small even as the task set grows. For example, two types suffice to cover a broad range of tabletop manipulation: transport, which relocates an object onto or into a receptacle, and fixture, which actuates an articulated element of the scene. All memory entries pertaining to a given type, from general execution rules to task-specific records, are therefore consolidated into a single source and compiled into a unified chunk, parameterized by the object classes on which it operates.
blocks.zh:
一个LLM代理的内存已经记录了一般的,可重复使用的成功规则和任务的程序背景. ChunkAct 将所有内存一次编译为可执行块形式,而不是让计划员在每一个步骤上重新开发(图3(a)).
内存构建从任务类别上的分区开始 。 操纵指令分解成按顺序排列的打字子目标的序列,即使任务组合不断增长,这类类型的空间仍然很小. 例如,有两种类型足以涵盖广泛的桌面操作:将物体移入或移入贮器的运输,以及引爆场景中明确内容的固定装置。 所有与特定类型相关的内存条目,从一般执行规则到任务特定记录,因此被合并为一个单一源,并编成一个统一的块,由其运行的对象类别参数化.

blocks.en: Compilation retains only the procedural knowledge that defines how a task type is executed: the ordering of stages, the primitive assigned to each stage, the stage-level parameters conditioned on object class, the fallback strategies to attempt when a stage fails, and the criteria used to verify each stage. The primitive assignment, for instance, preserves the division of labor recorded in memory, delegating contact-rich stages such as grasping or fixture actuation to the VLA policy and the remaining stages to analytic primitives. Conversely, any quantity unobservable at deployment time is excluded. Recorded coordinates and privileged simulator state are discarded, and all geometric quantities are re-estimated from live perception of the current scene. This decoupling allows a chunk to transfer to scenes whose layouts differ from those encountered during memory construction.
blocks.zh: 编译只保留了定义任务类型如何执行的程序知识:阶段的顺序,分配给每个阶段的原始参数,以对象类为条件的阶段级参数,一个阶段失败时尝试的倒置策略,以及用于验证每个阶段的标准. 例如,原始任务保留了记忆中记录的劳动分工,将接触丰富的阶段,如抓住或固定激活,交给志愿军政策,其余阶段交给分析原始人。 相反,在部署时无法观察的任何数量均排除在外。 录音坐标和特权模拟状态被丢弃,所有几何量都从对当前场景的现场感知中重新估计. 这种脱钩使得块可以转移到布局与内存构造时遇到的场景不同的地方.

blocks.en: The resulting chunk is an executable routine that captures the recurring procedure of its task type. A single chunk covers every task of its type, with class-dependent content resolved by lookup within the chunk. The planner is thus relieved of both memory retrieval and step-by-step primitive selection at run time. During execution, each stage is verified before the next begins, and the library is compiled once and kept frozen.
blocks.zh: 所产生的块是一个可执行的常规,它能够捕捉其任务类型的反复出现的程序. 单个块覆盖其类型中的每一项任务, 类依赖的内容通过块内查找来解决 。 因此,规划者在运行时既可以解除内存检索,也可以逐步选择原始. 执行期间,每个阶段在下一个阶段开始前都要经过核实,图书馆被编译一次并保持冻结.

blocks.en: 3.3 Online action chunk triggering
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 在线动作块触发

blocks.en: To sovle the ❷ problem, ChunkAct internalizes the memory ℳ \mathcal{M} into executable chunks, allowing memory-free execution at run time.
blocks.zh: 为了解决QQ问题, ChunkAct 将内存 M\ mathcal{M} 内化为可执行块, 允许运行时无内存执行 。

blocks.en:
At test time the planner invokes chunks in place of primitives, through a single tool call ( Figure 3 (b) labels ChunkAct ).
The instruction is parsed into its ordered sequence of typed sub-goals, each sub-goal selects the chunk of its kind, and the planner’s interface to execution narrows to two operations, grounding a target in the current observation and launching the chunks.
An episode therefore begins with the planner interpreting the task and the scene, grounding the first target, and issuing one call, after which the chunks run the sub-goals until the task is complete without any further request to the planner.
No memory is read along the way, since everything the planner would have retrieved has been compiled into the chunks, and the planner’s context holds only the instruction, the observations it has requested, and the exits it has received.
blocks.zh:
在测试时,规划者通过单一工具调用(图3(b)标签为Chunk Act )来引用块代替原始物。
该指示被解解为按顺序排列的打字子目标,每个子目标选择这种小块,计划者执行的接口缩小为两个行动,在目前的观察中打下一个目标并发射小块。
因此,一个插曲从规划者解释任务和场景开始,将第一个目标搁浅,并发出一个呼叫,然后块子运行子目标,直到任务完成,而无需向规划者进一步请求.
因为计划员本可以检索到的一切都被整理成块,

blocks.en:
Chaining the stages under one call, rather than exposing each stage as a separate call, follows from where reasoning is actually needed.
Compiling memory and perception into chunks removes the cost of retrieval and repeated observation, but a per-stage interface would still return control to the planner after every action, turning each step of execution into a round of deliberation.
Most of these rounds involve no decision.
blocks.zh:
将各个阶段放在一个呼叫下,而不是将每个阶段作为单独的呼叫,从实际需要推理的地方开始。
将内存和感知汇编成块可以消除检索和反复观察的成本,但每个阶段的接口仍然会在每次行动后将控制还给规划者,把执行的每个步骤变成一轮的审议.
这些回合中大多数没有决定。

blocks.en: Once its target is grounded, the stages of a sub-goal follow a fixed order, so a successful stage already determines the next one and requires no reasoning to select it. A chunk therefore chains the stages directly and returns control to the planner only when a stage fails.
blocks.zh: 一旦其目标得到确立,次级目标的各个阶段都遵循固定的顺序,所以一个成功的阶段已经决定了下一个阶段,不需要推理来选择它. 因此,一个块直接将各个阶段连在一起,只有当一个阶段失败时,才将控制权归还给规划者。

blocks.en:
Control returns to the planner only when a chunk fails, and it does so through a typed exit.
Every stage of a chunk raises its own error code, so the exit names the stage that failed and the reason it failed, such as a perception call that cannot locate its target, a policy call that loses the object, or a verification that cannot confirm the sub-goal, and it carries the error log with the robot state and fresh observations ( Appendix A ).
The planner then re-perceives the scene from its true state, and chooses among three responses, namely grounding the target again and re-invoking the chunk, redoing a sub-goal whose verification failed, or falling back to the primitives for a situation the library does not cover.
Each response is a decision that requires understanding the task and the scene, and none is a step of execution, so the planner is consulted at decision points and nowhere else.
blocks.zh:
控制只有在块失败时才会返回到规划器,它通过一个输入的退出来这样做.
块的每个阶段都会提出自己的错误代码,所以退出时会命名失败的舞台和它失败的原因,比如无法定位其目标的感知呼叫,丢失对象的政策呼叫,或者无法确认子目标的验证,它带着错误日志与机器人状态和新鲜的观察(附录A).
规划者然后从真实状态重新审视场景,从三个反应中选择,即再次击倒目标并重提块,重做一个被验证失败的子目标,或者为了图书馆无法覆盖的情况而回到原始人.
每一次回应都是一个需要了解任务和场景的决定,没有一个是执行的一步,因此在决定点和别的地方咨询规划者.

blocks.en: 3.4 Role of LLM planner in agentic robotics
blocks.zh: 3.4 LLM规划员在代理机器人中的作用

blocks.en: We examine how this design changes the role of the planner, from stepwise executor to sub-goal selector and failure handler.
blocks.zh: 我们审查这种设计如何改变规划者的作用,从逐步执行者到次级目标选择者和故障处理者。

blocks.en:
Taken together, the two stages redefine the role of the planner.
In the per-primitive loop of Equation 1 , the planner serves as both reasoner and executor, treating every step alike regardless of whether it requires judgment. ChunkAct separates the two: execution is delegated to the chunks, while the planner retains only what cannot be compiled, namely understanding the task and scene and responding to failure.
This separation reshapes both sides of the loop.
blocks.zh:
这两个阶段合在一起重新界定了规划者的作用。
在"方程式1"(Equation 1)的每首循环中,计划者既充当理性者,又充当执行者,无论是否需要判断,对每个步骤都一视同仁. ChunkAct将两者分开:执行权下放给块,而规划者只保留无法编译的东西,即理解任务和场景以及应对失败.
这种分离重塑了循环的两面.

blocks.en:
On the input side, the dominant sources of context are removed.
Memory is internalized in the chunks rather than retrieved online, and perception is performed within each chunk rather than requested before every primitive.
The context thus stays compact across an episode, containing only the instruction, decision-time observations, and exits.
On the output side, the unit of action shifts from a single primitive to a chained chunk.
Each step a t a_{t} is either a chunk launch or a response to an exit, so the planner is invoked per decision rather than per action, and reasoning is spent only where it is required.
Episode cost therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than procedure length.
blocks.zh:
在输入方面,主要上下文来源被移除.
内存被内化成块而不是在线检索,感知在每一个块内进行,而不是在每一个原始之前要求.
因此,整个事件的背景保持紧凑,只包含指令、决策时间观察和退出。
在输出方面,动作单位从一个原始的单块转移到一个链块.
t a_{t}的每个步骤要么是块发射,要么是对退出的反应,因此每个决定而不是每个行动都会引用规划者,推理只在需要的地方使用.
因此,费用按决定数量而不是程序长度计算。

The planner is GPT-5.6-sol at high reasoning effort running in Codex ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , with a budget of 100 LLM calls per episode.
The VLA primitive is π RLinf \pi_{\mathrm{RLinf}} , and SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) provides segmentation. ChunkAct and Harness VLA ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) share the same set-up and the same task-specific and global memory.
They differ only in how the memory is used: Harness VLA reads it at test time, whereas ChunkAct internalizes it offline into executable chunks and reads no explicit memory at test time.

计划者是GPT-5.6-sol,在Codex(OpenAI,2025年)中运行的高推理努力,每集的预算为100LLM调用.
VLA原始版为 RLinf\pi_{\mathrm{RLinf}},SAM 3(Carion等人,2026年)提供分化. ChunkAct and Harness VLA (Zhang et al., 2026c) 共享相同的设置以及相同的任务特定和全球记忆.
它们仅在记忆如何使用上有所不同: Harness VLA在测试时间读取它,而ChunkAct将其内化为可执行块,在测试时间读取不显式内存.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Task success performance. As shown in Table 1 , ChunkAct achieves the highest task success rate on LIBERO-Pro, outperforming both end-to-end VLAs and agentic robotic systems.
It attains an overall success rate of 83.8%, exceeding the strongest prior method, Harness VLA, by 5.0 points.
The perturbations in LIBERO-Pro, instruction redirection and position swap, require a policy to act on instructions and object layouts that differ from those seen in training, and end-to-end VLAs largely fail under them.
This failure extends to π RLinf \pi_{\mathrm{RLinf}} , the checkpoint that ChunkAct invokes as its contact primitive, which trails ChunkAct by 43.8 points.
Since the primitive alone does not generalize to these perturbations, whatever success an agent recovers must come from how it grounds the task in the current scene before the primitive is called.
Placing an LLM planner above the VLA recovers much loss, as the agentic baselines show, yet Harness VLA stops at 78.8% despite sharing the same planner, primitive, perception, and memory with ChunkAct .
The two systems differ only in how memory is used.
Harness VLA retrieves memory at test time and relies on the planner to reinterpret past experience at every call, whereas ChunkAct compiles it offline into executable chunks that encode how each task succeeds.
The gap therefore isolates the benefit of memory internalization.
blocks.zh:
任务成功性能. 如表1所示,ChunkAct在LIBERO-Pro上实现了最高的任务成功率,表现优于端对端的VLA和代理机器人系统.
它的总体成功率为83.8%,比以往最强的方法Harness VLA高出5.0个百分点。
LIBERO-Pro中的扰动,指令重定向和位置互换,需要一项政策来根据指令和对象布局采取行动,这些指令和对象布局与在训练中看到的不同,在它们下端到端的VLA基本失败.
此失败延伸至 ^ RLinf\pi_{\ mathrm{ RLinf}}, Chunk Act 引用的作为联系原始的检查点, 追踪 Chunk Act 的43.8 点.
由于原始人本身不能被概括到这些扰动中,任何一种物剂恢复的成功都必须来自它如何在现在的场景中证明任务的存在,然后才叫作原始人.
在VLA上方放置一个LLM计划员, 将损失恢复到相当程度, 正如代理基线所示,
两种系统仅在内存使用方式上有所不同.
Harness VLA在测试时间检索内存,并依靠计划员在每个呼叫时重新解释过去的经验,而ChunkAct将其离线编译为可执行块,以编码每个任务如何成功.
因此,这一缺口隔离了内存内化的好处.

blocks.en:
Efficiency analysis. As shown in Table 2 , ChunkAct attains its higher success rate at a fraction of the LLM cost.
The first two rows correspond to the Harness VLA and ChunkAct entries in Table 1 .
Relative to Harness VLA, ChunkAct issues 2.9 × \times fewer LLM calls and consumes 4.4 × \times fewer input tokens and 2.3 × \times fewer output tokens, while improving success by 5.0 points.
The third and fourth rows repeat this comparison with reasoning disabled, and the efficiency advantage of ChunkAct grows further.
Both observations stem from memory internalization.
Harness VLA spends most LLM calls on perception queries and memory reads, and each result is appended to the context, so the context keeps growing over the episode. ChunkAct folds these steps into the executable chunks, so they run at test time without invoking the LLM and their results never enter the context window.
The planner is called only at the decision points that the chunks leave open.
Fewer calls over a shorter context reduce the input tokens, and fewer planning decisions reduce the output tokens.
blocks.zh:
效率分析。 如表2所示,Chunk Act以最低生活水平成本的一小部分达到较高的成功率。
前两行对应表1中的Harness VLA和ChunkAct条目.

第三行和第四行重复了这种与推理残障的比较,ChunkAct的效率优势进一步增长.
这两种观测都来源于内存内化.
Harness VLA花费了大部分LLM调用感知查询和内存读取,每个结果都附在上下文中,因此上下文在剧集中不断增长. 块 动作将这些步骤折叠到可执行块中,所以它们在测试时运行而不引用LLM,其结果从不进入上下文窗口.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis of LLM planner role in ChunkAct
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析LLM规划者在Chunk Act中的作用

blocks.en:
Analyzing the LLM planner reasoning impact. As shown in Table 2 , ChunkAct remains robust when the reasoning of LLM planner is disabled, whereas Harness VLA does not.
The task success rate of ChunkAct stays stable across reasoning settings, while Harness VLA degrades sharply once reasoning is turned off.
This contrast reflects how heavily each system relies on the planner.
Harness VLA depends on the LLM at every step: each call must interpret the retrieved memory, decide what to perceive, and issue the correct next action, so the errors of a weaker planner accumulate over the episode. ChunkAct instead decouples the LLM from the execution it does not need to perform.
With memory already internalized into the chunks, the planner is consulted only for the remaining decisions, which leaves a weaker planner far fewer opportunities to fail.
blocks.zh:
分析LLM计划者推理影响. 如表2所示,当LLM计划员的推理被禁用时,ChunkAct仍然坚挺,而Harness VLA则没有.
ChunkAct的任务成功率在各推理设置之间保持稳定,而Harness VLA则在推理关闭后急剧下降.
这种对比反映了每个系统对规划者的依赖程度。
Harness VLA在每一个步骤上都取决于LLM:每一次呼叫都必须解释被检索的内存,决定什么是感知,并发出正确的下一步行动,因此较弱的规划者的错误会在剧集中积累. ChunkAct 将LLM与其不需要执行的执行脱钩.
由于内存已经内部化为块块,所以只就剩余的决定与规划者协商,这就使得较弱的规划者失败的机会要少得多.

blocks.en:
Quantifying the LLM agent’s contribution. To measure how much the planner contributes within ChunkAct , the last row of Table 2 executes the chunks under a scripted driver that makes no LLM call.
The chunks alone reach 57.5%, which corresponds to episodes in which the compiled routines succeed without intervention.
The LLM in ChunkAct without reasoning therefore accounts for the remaining 22.5 points.
This contribution comes from recovery: when a chunk fails, the planner is invoked to interpret the current scene and direct the next step, which a scripted driver cannot.
The LLM thus serves not as a step-by-step executor but as a recovery mechanism invoked where the compiled routine falls short, which is why it adds substantial success at a small cost in calls and tokens.
blocks.zh:
量化LLM代理的贡献. 为了衡量规划者在Chunk Act 中的贡献程度, 表 2 的最后一行执行脚本驱动程序下的块, 不使用 LLM 调用 。
光是块就达到57.5%,相当于编译的例行程序在没有干预的情况下成功的事件.
因此,《Chunk Act》中的LLM没有推理,占了其余的22.5分。
这种贡献来自恢复:当块失败时,会引用规划者来解释当前场景并指导下一步,而脚本驱动程序是无法做到的.
因此,LLM不是一步步的执行者,而是在汇编的例行程序不足时援引的恢复机制,因此它以很小的代价在电话和信使方面增加了实质性的成功。

blocks.en: 4.4 Generalization to unseen perturbations
blocks.zh: 4.4 向看不见的扰动泛化

blocks.en:
Out-of-distribution test. The memory of ChunkAct is compiled on LIBERO-Pro and includes task-specific memory, which prior work found necessary on that benchmark ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
To test whether ChunkAct overfits to these tasks, we apply it unchanged to LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , which perturbs the LIBERO tasks along seven dimensions that the memory doesn’t cover.
The chunk library and planner prompt are those of Section 4.2 , so the evaluation is fully zero-shot, whereas the VLA baselines, whose numbers are taken from Fei et al. (2025) , are fine-tuned on the benchmark data.
blocks.zh:
外传经验. ChunkAct的内存在LIBERO-Pro上编译,并包含任务特定内存,之前的工作认为该基准是必要的(Zhang等人,2026c.).
为了检验Chunk Act是否超额完成这些任务,我们将它不加修改地应用于LiBERO-Plus(Fei等人,2025年),它让LiBERO的任务沿着记忆所没有覆盖的七个维度进行。
块库和规划员的提示是第4.2节的提示,因此评价是完全零拍的,而从Fei等人(2025年)获得的VLA基线则根据基准数据进行微调。

blocks.en:
Zero-shot transfer. ChunkAct achieves the best overall success rate in Table 3 , exceeding the strongest prior method by 11.0 points and leading in six of the seven dimensions.
The margin is widest under camera and robot initial-state perturbations, where ChunkAct stays above three quarters while the best VLA falls to two thirds and one half, respectively.
Because a chunk recomputes its targets from perception in every episode, such changes alter the measured geometry but not the procedure.
These results show zero-shot transfer of internalized memory to unseen perturbations rather than overfitting to the tasks it was compiled from.
blocks.zh:
零射转机. ChunkAct在表3中取得了最佳的总体成功率,超过最强的先前方法11.0分,并在7个维度中的6个维度领先.
相机和机器人初始状态扰动下的比值最宽,ChunkAct停留在四分之三以上,而最佳VLA则分别降到三分之二和一半.
由于一个块从每集的感知中重新计算出它的目标,这些变化改变了测量的几何而不是程序.
这些结果显示,内化内存的零射移到看不见的扰动中,而不是过度适应它所编译的任务.

blocks.en: 4.5 Qualitative analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 定性分析

blocks.en:
Figure 4 follows a single LIBERO-Pro episode and shows how the planner’s eight calls are distributed over 22 seconds of execution.
The planner is engaged at two points only.
At the start it views the scene and launches a chunk, which grasps and lifts the can without further LLM request.
During the move, however, the can slips out of the gripper, and the chunk terminates with a typed exit.
It returns a hand-off block, a structured error report that adds context to the error code.
The planner resumes from the true state of the scene rather than from its expectation of it, spends four calls re-pointing the can, and triggers ChunkAct again, which carries the can to the basket, places it, and finishes on its own once the environment reports success.
The episode makes visible the division of labor that Table 2 quantifies.
The planner is reserved for understanding, while the chunks handle execution.
It plans the next action chunk from the scene, and re-plans when a chunk fails.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Agentic robotics generalizes to novel tasks without retraining, but at a steep cost in efficiency. We identify two bottlenecks: the LLM planner reasons before every primitive, although the primitives of a sub-goal follow a recurring pattern, and most of its calls are spent on perception and memory retrieval rather than action. ChunkAct is the first work to introduce action chunking to agentic robotics, and it internalizes memory into executable chunks offline. The LLM is thereby decoupled from routine execution and engaged only where reasoning is genuinely required, which improves LLM efficiency significantly. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the SOTA method with 2.9 × \times fewer LLM calls, 4.4 × \times fewer input tokens, and 2.3 × \times fewer output tokens, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen tasks on LIBERO-Plus.
blocks.zh: 代理机器人在不进行再培训的情况下一般化为新任务,但效率成本高昂. 我们找出两个瓶颈:LLM规划者在每一个原始人面前的理由,虽然一个次级目标的原始人遵循一种反复出现的模式,它的大部分呼吁都用于感知和内存检索而不是行动. ChunkAct是第一个将动作块引入代理机器人的作品,它将内存内部化为离线可执行块. 因此,LLM与常规执行脱钩,只在真正需要推理时才参与,这大大提高了LLM的效率. 在LIBERO-Pro上,ChunkAct比SOTA方法提高了5.0分的任务成功率,使用2.9×\时的LLM调用次数减少,4.4×\时的输入符数减少,2.3×\时的输出符数减少,它将零拍到LIBERO-Plus上的隐形任务.
